definitions.explanation: the act of moving into a new residence, apartment, or facility

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{入居|にゅうきょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm scheduled to move in next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入居|にゅうきょ}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This apartment building has a high occupancy rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入居|にゅうきょ}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Move-ins to the new condominium will begin next spring.

notes:
RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{退去|たいきょ}→退去：06693_taikyo⟧ - moving out (opposite)
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し - moving (relocating in general)
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧ - changing residence

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入居|にゅうきょ}⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ - tenant screening
- {入居|にゅうきょ}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ - occupancy rate
- {入居|にゅうきょ}⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ - move-in conditions/requirements
- {入居|にゅうきょ}{者|しゃ} - resident, tenant
- {入居|にゅうきょ}⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧ - move-in ready

USAGE:
Used for apartments, condominiums, nursing homes, dormitories, and other residential facilities. For nursing homes and care facilities, {入居|にゅうきょ} emphasizes taking up residence rather than admission (⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧).
